verdict.rationale: Angular is a web framework, and its ecosystem could plausibly offer bulk operations such as codemods across many files, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no bulk-operation capability. CLI commands that generate or modify files via a schematic, or update a workspace, are general tooling and not a documented feature for acting on many items at once, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
